english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to comply with requirement to give notice of absence to Care Quality Commission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), failed to give notice in writing to the Commission, as soon as reasonably practicable, of an event specified in regulation 15(1) of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009, namely **(..SPECIFY EVENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15 and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
